cases.command: rm -f data/check-list.jsonl
ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list
: > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list
ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs add exercise
ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs add "buy milk"
ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs add 'tea	"milk"\café later'
ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list
ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list unexpected

isolated=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R src "$isolated/src" && mkdir "$isolated/data" && printf '{"name":"exercise"}\n' > "$isolated/data/items.jsonl" && env -u ITEMS_FILE node "$isolated/src/cli.mjs" list && ITEMS_FILE= node "$isolated/src/cli.mjs" list
ITEMS_FILE=data node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' '{}
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' 'null
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' '[]
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' '{"name":5}
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' '{"name":" x"}
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' '{"name":"x\ny"}
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' '{"name":"x\ry"}
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list

printf '%s' '{"name":"x","extra":1}
' > data/check-list.jsonl && ITEMS_FILE=data/check-list.jsonl node src/cli.mjs list
